root_cause_classification.metadata: Source-derived titles were absent before rebuild and are now correct; title search alone did not resolve expected-source acquisition.
root_cause_classification.routing: Routing accuracy is 0.65; at least Q039 has a route mismatch despite retrieving both expected documents.
root_cause_classification.sql_join_filter: Structured retrieval returns provenance-rich rows but frequently misses expected report families; its broad joins and term constraints require family-level diagnosis.
root_cause_classification.structured_extraction: No new source-to-database record-count defect was proven by this evaluation; structured retrieval failure is not evidence of source extraction failure.
root_cause_classification.version_handling: Version-family queries require explicit content-evidence grouping; filename suffixes remain inadmissible chronology evidence.
root_cause_classification.lexical_ranking: Current OR-term lexical ranking admits generic corpus rows and fails expected report-family acquisition.
root_cause_classification.cross_document_logic: Cross-document accuracy is 0.25 because fusion preserves only candidates already acquired; it does not acquire all required source families.
root_cause_classification.invalid_evaluation_expectation: Q014 expects a corrupted excluded source to be retrieved as production evidence. The live database correctly excludes it; any audit-only expectation must be evaluated through the forensic artifact, not production retrieval.

decision: Do not enable embeddings or semantic search to conceal these deterministic contract failures. Retain the rebuilt corpus and repair retrieval through generic metadata, family discovery, and version-evidence contracts.
